A QUICK INTRODUCTION

Same answers.
Different truths.

  1. Find nine answers. Solve short trivia clues. Stuck? Use a letter hint or reveal an answer.
  2. Find three trios. Select three answers with something in common. All three groups should use the same lens.
  3. Change your perspective. Use every answer again to find three different trios. Each new trio contains one answer from each original group.

Either connection can come first. Mistakes are unlimited. This is a single example puzzle; progress stays in this browser.
